(1) TWO typefaces inside one 130px block, read from rasterisation via CDP CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode, not from declarations: 'No matches' and its body sentence are Plus Jakarta Sans, and the 'Clear "zzqqxx-no-such-record"' pill sitting 100px directly beneath them is Inter. r6 counted three faces across the screen; r7 cut it to two but moved the seam into the empty state's own headline-and-button pair, which is the worst place for it. Wave's screen is one face throughout. (2) TWO controls are still literally called 'search': the 280x40 text input at x=133 and the 220x40 filter select at x=461 both render the placeholder as lowercase 'search', on a screen whose copy says 'Try a different word', while every neighbour is Title Case (Export to Excel, Show Deleted, Refresh, Add New Invoice). Unaddressed since r6. (3) The zero-state is still a second-class citizen. /invoice and /customer get the tile, the sentence-case headline, the query-aware sentence and a real Clear pill; /payment, which is genuinely empty, gets the tile plus AntD's Title Case 'No Data Found' / 'Records you add will be listed here.' and NO action - and its toolbar is Filters / Export to Excel / Refresh, so a core financial list with zero records offers the user nothing to do. That is the empty state a Wave-class product treats best, and it is the one left generic. (4) /payment still ships the sticky-column defect r3 and r6 named: the pale header band ramps grey to the right of 'Payment Mode' then STEPS at a hard vertical seam into a lighter panel that carries the rounded top-right corner, so the band reads as two mismatched tones. /invoice is clean; the fix was applied to one page and not the other. (5) A real product element, the 56px fixed circular FAB titled 'AI Assistant (locked) - click to configure', parks bottom-right; on mobile it lands in the gap between the empty card and the tab bar. It is the only circle on a screen otherwise built from pills and 8px fields, and it advertises a locked feature on a screen about finding records.
